basic_info.description: Residence #105 at LuXe in Pacific Heights comes with extra special advantages: This 1BR includes a good-sized den/office with plenty of space for a desk & comfortable seating; full bath plus a powder room; beautifully landscaped, full-width deeded patio; no need to use the elevator to enter the residence from the lobby level; and all on the quiet north side of the building - no street traffic, just peaceful living surrounded by nature that someone else tends. This is a condominium with high style & a truly superb floor plan. Tasteful white & grey finishes are the unifying aesthetic. Wide plank pale oak floors, closet organizers, W/D & custom window coverings. The kitchen offers high-end appliances, white quartz counters, glossy white cabinets offset with a wall of textured grey wood cabinets. It all works effortlessly. Whether preparing a meal or lounging about in the LR or BR, the view is of the garden. Italian tiled bath with sep. shower & tub. SBS garage pkg. Fabulous!
